highlights_headline: Upcoming 4.156 changes improve rendering reliability and align Uno and Apple platform requirements.
highlights_body: Android texture rendering follows the display clock, Linux HarfBuzz avoids conflicting system-library calls, and native callbacks use the correct boolean widths. Additional changes reduce pixel-copy and text-formatting allocations. Review the Uno migration, Apple minimums, and buffer-length validation before upgrading.

breaking.title: Uno views move to Uno Platform 7
breaking.body: The non-Windows Uno views require Uno Platform 7 and net10.0; older native-renderer packages and WasmShell integration are removed. SKSwapChainPanel now derives from Grid, uses raster rendering, reports a null GRContext, and drops RaiseOnUnsupported. Migrate GPU drawing to SKCanvasElement and WASM builds to the .NET SDK path. Windows continues to use the WinAppSDK control.

breaking.title: Apple deployment floors increase
breaking.body: SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp native libraries now require macOS 11 or iOS, tvOS, and Mac Catalyst 14. Managed iOS/tvOS minimums rise to 14; managed macOS 12 and Mac Catalyst 15 minimums remain unchanged. Update deployment settings and retain any higher framework or application requirements.

breaking.title: SKData.CreateCopy rejects oversized lengths
breaking.body: SKData.CreateCopy(byte[], ulong) now throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException when the requested length exceeds the source array. Pass a length within the array rather than relying on an out-of-bounds native read.

breaking.title: Custom WebAssembly archives need bundled WebGPU support
breaking.body: Newer-than-.NET-8 WebAssembly consumers now link emdawnwebgpu C++ support from libSkiaSharp.a rather than compiling webgpu.cpp during application linking. Use the rebuilt native assets; custom archives must include the port object with Graphite enabled. Pre-change and GPU-disabled custom archives do not satisfy this contract. The .NET 8 built-in WebGPU path is unchanged.

bullets.detail: Updates Skia m156 to reject overflowing Raster Pipeline slot and temporary-stack counts and reject invalid runtime-effect types such as sampler2D and texture2D during parsing.
Disables BGRA8-as-RGBx uploads that advertised GL_RGBA, a combination invalid in GLES. Readback behavior is unchanged.
Updates the WinUI ANGLE dependency to chromium/8118 while leaving the WinUI project's declared Windows 10 build 17763 minimum unchanged.

Uses one-byte values for Skia C bool callbacks and four-byte integers for HarfBuzz hb_bool_t callbacks, correcting ABI mismatches including Apple ARM64 interpreter returns. Public managed delegates still use bool; false glyph-name callbacks no longer copy a name.

Binds internal HarfBuzz function calls to the bundled Linux implementation, preventing system HarfBuzz loaded by GTK from redirecting calls and mixing incompatible private objects. Exported entry points and managed signatures remain unchanged.

Paces automatic GLTextureView and MAUI SKGLView render loops with Choreographer instead of unbounded buffer-swap throughput. Drawing stays on the GL worker; explicit render requests and lifecycle work remain independent of display callbacks.

StringUtilities.GetUnicodeCharacterCode now validates a single encoded code unit by byte width and decodes it correctly; supplementary code points require UTF-32. GetString(byte[], SKTextEncoding) now throws ArgumentNullException for null data instead of NullReferenceException.
Fixes a native buffer over-read in FromCString and writes directly into SKData.

Moves emdawnwebgpu C++ compilation into the native archive so application C sources no longer receive incompatible C++ flags. JavaScript compiler glue remains a link input rather than deployed application content.

Copies valid managed image pixel buffers without intermediate SKData, pools the UTF-32 encoding buffer for HarfBuzz AddUtf32 strings, and avoids native allocation when formatting HarfBuzz feature strings while preserving existing decoding behavior.

Disposing SKFrontBufferedManagedStream now clears its reference to the wrapped stream even when disposeUnderlyingStream is false. The borrowed stream is not disposed; its caller remains responsible for disposal.

Aligns WinUI, MAUI, and Uno library dependencies with Windows App SDK 1.7.250909003 and Windows SDK BuildTools 10.0.22621.756. This does not change public APIs or the declared Windows runtime minimum.
